summary: Iter 21 — FRONTEND-ONLY verification of RemedialFlow operational improvements (viewport 390x844, Expo web preview). All 8 review checkpoints pass. (1) Admin /admin/deleted: deleted-search filters by ref/address (verified via API: q=ITER21->16, q=THROWAWAY->0, q=ZZZ->0 — matching rendered rows), restore-<REF> and purge-<REF> buttons present per row; purge-<REF> opens purge-sheet with purge-confirm-input and purge-confirm; typing WRONG keeps purge-confirm non-functional and typing exact ref enables it; confirming removes the row and the bin is updated (ITER21-THROWAWAY gone after purge). (2) Admin /admin/settings INSTALLER RATES: rate-installer-dropdown opens rate-installer-sheet with 27 rate-installer-option-<id> entries; picking Ian (6ad6335a4535baee71105ba1) shows installer-rate-input prefilled with 150; entering 'abc' + Save renders installer-rate-error; entering 175 + Save fires PATCH /admin/users/{id} {default_rate:175}, button becomes 'Saved' and reopen+pick shows 175; restored to 150 afterward. (3) Employee /project/<id> (TEST-P10-35E86F, 6ad813767b86abb86a200af4): NO project-rates section rendered, no 'Installer rates' text in DOM, no £ amounts above the NC list; project-progress-text reads exactly 'Project Progress: 0 of 1 NCs Completed'; project-schedules shows Ian with schedule-input-6ad6335a4535baee71105ba1; typing today DD/MM/YYYY and tapping schedule-save-* persists via PUT /projects/{pid}/schedule/{iid}. (4) Admin view of SAME project: project-rates IS rendered (verified count=1). (5) Staff Approve: on TEST-P11APR NC-01 in employee_review, expanding StaffNCCard and tapping approve-NC-01 → approved-state-NC-01 appears, approve-NC-01 button disappears. (6) Installer Earnings tab: earnings-summary with earnings-potential (£37,585.00), earnings-unpaid (£1,100.00), earnings-paid (£57,150.00); earnings-section-potential rendered ('POTENTIAL EARNINGS · ESTIMATED · N'); rows have 'Your NCs: ...' and 'Estimated' badge. (7) Installer Jobs tab: sections rendered for action, this_week, unscheduled, completed; job-card-TEST-P10-35E86F appears in CURRENT WEEK because we scheduled it today, with job-schedule-TEST-P10-35E86F='Scheduled 21/10/2026' and job-ncs-* showing 'Your NCs: NC-01'. (8) Fully-approved project (TEST-TM-B74EED, 2/2 approved, status=completed) renders project-status badge text 'Internally completed'. Seed: 1 throwaway project ITER21-THROWAWAY created via employee then soft-deleted and purged in the UI. Backend untouched — no issues observed.
action_items: No code changes required for iter-21 scope. All 8 acceptance checkpoints pass end-to-end on the web preview at 390x844.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/app/admin/deleted.tsx: deleted-search debounced via React Query keyed on [q, term] with URL-encoded q param; purge-confirm correctly uses disabled={typed.trim() !== purge?.ref} (strict equality incl. case). Row removal is driven by qc.invalidateQueries after successful 200 — verified.

frontend/app/admin/settings.tsx InstallerRate: regex /^\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$/ with upper bound 100000; stripping leading £ before validation; PATCH /admin/users/{id} with default_rate as Number; 'Saved' label held until the user edits again (setSaved(false) on onChangeText) — verified by second-pick showing persisted 175.

frontend/app/project/[id].tsx: ScheduleRows parses DD/MM/YYYY → YYYY-MM-DD before PUT /projects/{pid}/schedule/{iid}; empty input sends date:null; project-rates block gated by `isAdmin && p.rate_rows?.length` so employees never see rates (confirmed: emp count=0, admin count=1 for same project); project-progress-text format matches 'Project Progress: X of Y NCs Completed'.

frontend/src/components/StaffNCCard.tsx: approve action does optimistic qc.setQueryData flipping nc.status to 'approved' before refetch, so approved-state-NC-xx replaces approve-NC-xx without a visible flicker; buttons use disabled={!!busy} to block duplicate submissions — verified by UI test.

frontend/app/(installer)/earnings.tsx: three tiles always rendered when d exists; sections filtered by non-empty data; potential rows show 'Your NCs: ... · N/Total approved' and an 'Estimated' Badge; no fabricated amounts (uses backend r.p.amount).

frontend/app/(installer)/jobs.tsx sectionOf: deterministic single-section placement; 'this_week' includes overdue (d < nextMon); 'next_week' when d < afterNext; 'upcoming' otherwise. 'action' prioritizes rejected/more_evidence over schedule — confirmed cards appear once each in jobs-section-* and card shows job-ncs-<REF> + job-schedule-<REF>.
seed_data_creation: Created employee project ITER21-THROWAWAY (1 Test Street, TE1 1ST), soft-deleted it via DELETE /api/projects/{pid}, then purged it through the UI. Set schedule for installer Ian on TEST-P10-35E86F to today for the this_week jobs test. Ian's default_rate briefly changed to 175 then restored to 150. One NC on TEST-P11APR-1792502160 was Approved by the employee during the Approve test (irreversible for this iteration — flagging for next run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The approve test consumed TEST-P11APR-1792502160 NC-01 (status now approved). If a future test needs an employee_review NC, pick another from GET /api/review-queue?status=employee_review or create one via the backend seed. The schedule for Ian on TEST-P10-35E86F is set to today's date — if run on another day, this needs resetting. Backend endpoints confirmed via direct calls: GET /api/admin/deleted-projects?q=... (partial match on ref+address, case-insensitive), PATCH /api/admin/users/{id} {default_rate}, POST /api/admin/projects/{pid}/purge {confirm_ref}, PUT /api/projects/{pid}/schedule/{iid} {date}. Login quick-buttons on /login auto-fill the three demo credentials. aria-disabled was observed null for Btn in disabled state in RN web — rely on functional outcome (purge only fires when ref matches) rather than attribute reads.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all acceptance criteria met on the first UI pass.
